verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs say agents can operate inboxes, email, threads and attachments "using natural language" through its Google ADK integration. It also runs a first-party hosted MCP server and installable skills, so Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and similar agents can drive the product conversationally. However, AgentMail ships no built-in natural-language interface: the natural-language layer always comes from an external agent or LLM client the user supplies. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product or console, hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: your agent can create inboxes, send and receive emails, manage threads, and handle attachments using natural language.
AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
